title: Article 44 — Uniform civil code for the citizens

content.overview: Article 44 directs the State to endeavour to secure for the citizens a uniform civil code throughout the territory of India.
content.glance: State to endeavour to secure a uniform civil code for citizens throughout India.
content.study:
Article 44 is the uniform civil code directive. It is non-justiciable under Article 37. The Supreme Court has repeatedly referred to it as a constitutional aspiration (e.g. in personal-law reform contexts) without treating it as a directly enforceable right.

Examination: uniform civil code; endeavour (not mandatory immediate enactment); citizens; throughout India; non-justiciable.

sections.heading: Key directive
sections.body: Endeavour to secure a uniform civil code for the citizens throughout the territory of India.

questionsAndAnswers.question: What does Article 44 provide?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Article 44 directs the State to endeavour to secure for the citizens a uniform civil code throughout the territory of India. Like other Directive Principles, it is not enforceable by any court under Article 37.

examTips: Uniform civil code; endeavour; non-justiciable under Art 37.

keyTakeaways: Art 44: uniform civil code aspiration for citizens.
